title: SYNTHETIC maximum building height, attestation-conditional (M5-T054 proposal-checks wiring proof)
description: SYNTHETIC fixture (M5-T054, D-076 phase B2) proving the proposal-checks module surfaces COULD_NOT_CHECK when a REQUIRED attested input is absent: this synthetic max_building_height is gated on a caller-attested street_width_class, so with no attestation the evaluator returns professional_review_required and NO allowance - the check is COULD_NOT_CHECK naming the missing attestation, never a default width, a silent pass, or a fail-closed-to-narrow guess (D-051). The OUTPUT name (max_building_height) matches the real r5-height rule so the same declared check runs against both the synthetic and the real registry. In the REAL registry max_building_height is street-width INDEPENDENT (r5-height, section 23-422); this synthetic gate exercises only the module's attested/unattested COULD_NOT_CHECK behavior, not R5 legal semantics. Illustrative values only; not a Verified determination and not an official capture.
